title: Objects, prototypes, and OOP map
intro: This module teaches how JavaScript models objects at runtime: literals and descriptors, the prototype chain, class syntax as sugar, composition over deep inheritance, # private fields, the this binding matrix, and how all of it differs from C# CLR types and erased TypeScript.

overviewDiagram.title: JavaScript OOP building blocks
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  START[Model behavior] --> LIT[Object literals\nkeys and descriptors]
  LIT --> PROTO[Prototype chain\n[[Prototype]] lookup]
  PROTO --> CLASS[class sugar\nconstructor extends super]
  START --> COMPOSE{Reuse how?}
  COMPOSE -->|has-a| COMP[Composition\nfactories and injection]
  COMPOSE -->|is-a small| EXT[extends\nshared prototype methods]
  CLASS --> THIS[this binding matrix\ncall site rules]
  CLASS --> PRIV["# private fields\nruntime encapsulation"]
  PROTO --> VS[vs C# and TS\nerasure versus metadata]

conceptCards.title: Object literals and descriptors
conceptCards.summary: Own properties with writable, enumerable, configurable flags. Symbols for unique keys. Methods are function properties — this is separate.

conceptCards.title: Prototype chain
conceptCards.summary: Lookup walks [[Prototype]] until null. Function.prototype wires instances from new. Prefer getPrototypeOf over __proto__.

conceptCards.title: Classes as sugar
conceptCards.summary: class desugars to constructor + prototype. extends links prototypes. super in ctor before this. typeof MyClass is function.
conceptCards.example: class LtiHandler extends AuthHandler { parse(raw) { return super.parse(raw); } }

conceptCards.title: Inheritance versus composition
conceptCards.summary: Compose dependencies in factories and services. Reserve extends for shallow polymorphic hierarchies. Mixins copy — collision risk.

conceptCards.title: Private fields and encapsulation
conceptCards.summary: # fields are engine-enforced. TS private erases. Symbols hide from enumeration, not security. WeakMap for legacy patterns.

conceptCards.title: this binding matrix
conceptCards.summary: Default, implicit, explicit call/apply/bind, new, arrow lexical. Detached methods lose implicit this — FAANG favorite.
conceptCards.example: const f = obj.handle; f() // undefined this in strict

conceptCards.title: JS OOP versus C# and TS
conceptCards.summary: Runtime is objects and prototypes. TS types erase. CLR keeps nominal types, interfaces, and virtual slots.
conceptCards.example: instanceof works for classes; TS interfaces do not exist at runtime
